title: Clopen system projection is the specified direct-image unit
statement: Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be any inverse sequence of commutative rings. For a scheme $X$, use its small pro-etale site and the ordinary and derived strict semilinear module-system operations of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], with the simultaneous models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Let $s:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion with closed image and let $c:X\setminus s(U)\hookrightarrow X$ be its complementary open. Write $J_s\dashv P_s\dashv S_s$, with open unit $u_s$ and direct-image unit $\eta_s$. Let $t_s:J_s\to S_s$ be the $P_s\dashv S_s$ transpose of $u_s^{-1}:P_sJ_s\to1$, and let $\pi_s:1\to J_sP_s$ be identity on the selected clopen component and zero on its complement [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows]. Then $t_s$ is invertible and $(t_sP_s)\circ\pi_s=\eta_s$. Under the open-unit identification, $P_s\pi_s=1$, while $P_c\pi_s=0$. All comparisons are transformations on the whole system derived category, natural in the coefficient sequence and induced by the corresponding ordinary section formulas.

proof.text: Compare the exact localized adjunction with the specified right-derived adjunction by their unit factorization on the homotopy category. The localization factor isomorphisms cancel, and the normalized exact/right-derived comparison identifies the units. The same calculation localizes the ordinary inverse open unit and its transpose. Thus clopenToDirect followed by the exact/right-derived comparison is the localization of moduleOpenToP.

proof.text: Localize modulePi composed with moduleOpenToP equals the ordinary right unit to obtain the projector equation. The adjunction triple and its triangle identity give restriction to the selected component. For the complementary component, the disjoint_extension helper of the existing complementary-component lemma makes the target zero; exact localization preserves this zero target. The localized transpose calculation also gives the required normalization on actual cochain representatives.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary coefficient pushforward comparison by pushforward composition and coefficient-ring naturality; its section maps are identities, so sectionwise extensionality proves uniqueness. Transport the open pullback adjunction to the explicit ringed-site open inverse image. Its coefficient restriction isomorphism obeys the unit equation, so its inverse mate is the specified coefficient pull comparison. Localize this mate equation using exactDerivedMate. Uniqueness of right adjoints identifies its invertible direct-image mate with clopenCoefficientP. Full faithfulness of open extension and the clopen open-to-direct-image isomorphisms then give invertibility of clopenCoefficientJInv.

proof.text: The four naturality equations follow from the two unit equations: express the clopen comparison as the transpose of the inverse open unit, and cancel its invertible component to obtain projector naturality. Restriction comparisons obey those unit equations by the mates identities. For scalar extension, use its specified adjunctions. Iterating mates around the square gives conjugation between composite adjunctions. Conjugation reflects invertibility and takes inverses to inverses, yielding invertibility of the scalar pull and extension comparisons and both scalar unit equations. The same four-square argument yields scalar naturality; its open-to-direct-image square then gives invertibility of the scalar direct-image comparison. This uses the given unbounded scalar adjunctions without a new tensor decomposition.
